I am a PhD candidate in Social Policy at the [London School of Economics](https://www.lse.ac.uk), supervised by [Stephen Jenkins](https://www.lse.ac.uk/social-policy/people/academic-staff/Professor-Stephen-Jenkins) and [Francisco Ferreira](https://www.lse.ac.uk/people/francisco-h.-g.-ferreira). My research lies at the intersection of social policy, welfare analysis, development economics, and social economics, with a particular emphasis on methodological work.

**I am currently on the 2026–27 academic job market.**

## Research Interests

Poverty and inequality · Labour economics · Applied econometrics · Computational social science
